_doc: Iron Butterfly B2 — wide wings (4 strikes) + v2 regime gate + calendar filter. May 7 2026 sweep result: FIRST positive IB variant on 173-day post-SEBI corpus (+₹5.8/trade, 38 trips, Sharpe +0.06). Doubling wing width from 2 to 4 strikes flipped IB from -₹41/trade to +₹5.8/trade — gamma cushion was the binding constraint, not exit policy. Capital-efficiency: ~₹1.5L SPAN margin per lot (vs IC v2's ₹2.5L), so 1.67× more lots per ₹1L of capital. On the 173-day window, IB B2 delivered ₹149 absolute PnL per ₹1L vs IC v2 + cal's ₹105 — the higher frequency more than offsets lower per-trade EV. Recommended for capital-constrained books. Deploy alongside IC v2 + calendar (ic_2) for direct A/B in shadow paper.
